about: Sprite-family art bindings, read by UDinkArtFamilySubsystem at screen activation and by Scripts/art_coverage.py. Visual only: placements keep their collision, hardness, origin IDs and scripts. Precedence: origin and screen bindings in the other Data/Art manifests win; a sequence row with a `frame` (one picture) wins over a class id row, which wins over a plain sequence row. fit none (the default): real-size meshes standing at the card's ground point, like the player and the dressed screens. Rules: SourceAssets/Art/ART_STANDARD.md. Optional `variants` (further mesh paths): a placement picks the main mesh or a variant by a stable hash of its origin ID. Optional `yaw_offset` (degrees) is added to the chosen yaw. Optional `anchor_front` (0..1) stands the mesh's front edge, not its centre, on the sprite's bottom edge. Optional `span` ("width" or "height" for edge-on strips): the module is repeated along its X axis and scaled along X only until it fills that dimension of the layout-scaled card (interior wall runs: the kit is 0.025 m per pixel, interiors are laid out at 0.0438); `span` "stretch" scales one module along X to the card width (the arch); `span_fill` is the mesh of the further modules and `span_end` (left/right) the end the main mesh keeps.
